title_zh: 按规律排序：哎呀呀，全乱了
title_en: Sorting by Pattern: Oh No, It's All Mixed Up!
source_file: 按规律排序：哎呀呀，全乱了（5-8岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 数学来了！
找规律，发现物体的排列规律并进行排序
按规律排序
哎呀呀，全乱了
钟林姣 文  碧曼 绘
金盾出版社

[P2] 月亮街上有一座屋顶尖尖的房子，房子里面住着一位好心
眼儿女巫。
只要月亮街上的孩子敲响那扇大大的门，好心眼儿女巫就
会用魔法变出稀奇古怪的玩意儿。
比如——
吃了会做美梦的
棒棒糖。
能跳到云朵上的
弹跳鞋。

[P3] 要是——
那个孩子打嗝打得停不下来，去找好心眼儿女巫准没错。只要喝下一口红色的魔法药水——你是不是想说：马上就不会打嗝了呗！

错了！错了！
那个打嗝的孩子依然打嗝，不过，他只要一打嗝，嘴巴里就会飘出彩色的云朵来。先是红色的，再是黄色的，然后是蓝色的，接着还是红色的，再是黄色的……
黄色之后是什么颜色的云朵呢？没错，是蓝色的。那蓝色之后呢？是红色的。红色之后呢？
有完没完啊，问个没完的人有时候不太可爱哦。
好吧，好吧，不问了。

[P4] 要是——
哪个孩子做了噩梦很害怕，去找好心眼儿女巫准没错。只要
他对着一个彩虹条纹的口袋说出噩梦——你是不是想说：噩梦变
成好梦了呗！

错了！错了！
那个做了噩梦的孩子依然记得噩梦，不过，那个彩虹条纹的口
袋里会跳出小怪兽来。先是头上没有长角的怪兽，再是头上长着一
只角的，然后是头上长着两只角的，接着还是头上没有长角的……
然后呢？没有长角的怪兽后面会跳出什么小怪兽呢？没错，是
头上长了一只角的。然后会跳出什么小怪兽呢？
有完没完啊，问个没完的人有时候不太可爱哦。
好吧，好吧，不问了。

[P5] 要是——
要是好心眼儿女巫能用魔法让月亮街下一场雨就好了，月亮街好长时间没下雨了。

好心眼儿女巫正在努力记起让天空下雨的方法。其实方法很简单，可是好心眼儿女巫忘记了。

真是抱歉呀！

[P6] 小男孩杰克和小女孩米拉来找好心眼儿女巫，看看能不能帮助她找回让天空下雨的方法。
那扇大大的门没有关，好心眼儿女巫正趴在桌子上睡觉。她已经几天几夜没睡觉了。嘘！不要打扰她，让她好好睡一觉。
杰克和米拉来到好心眼儿女巫放满了魔法药水的柜子前。装药水的瓶子有各种各样的形状，米拉从右往左、从上到下地打量着，发现它们按顺序有规律地排列着：先是大肚子瓶子，再是细细长长的瓶子，然后是星星瓶子。

[P7] 忽然——
哗啦啦！
杰克不小心把柜子里的瓶子撞到了地上。
哎呀呀，全乱了！
幸好没有打破瓶子，幸好没有吵醒好心眼儿女巫。
杰克和米拉按照之前的顺序把瓶子放回柜子里，他们一边放一边念："大肚子瓶子，细细长长的瓶子，星星瓶子；大肚子瓶子，细细长长的瓶子，星星瓶子……"

[P8] “嗝……嗝……”忽然，米拉打起嗝来。杰克给米拉找了一瓶可以止住打嗝的红色药水——它装在大肚子瓶子里。
“试试看！”
可米拉的打嗝声却越来越大……
“好吵——”好心眼儿女巫被米拉的打嗝声吵醒了。她烦躁地跳起来。
“哦，天哪，你吐出了这么多的乌云。”好心眼儿女巫惊呆了，好半天才回过神来说了一句话。
米拉不是来玩的，她不想吐出彩色的云朵。如果，她把三种瓶子里的药水都喝下一点，会怎么样呢？

[P9] 是的，当米拉喝下三种形状瓶子的药水后，
她每打一次嗝，嘴巴里就飘出一朵朵乌云来：
先是小乌云，再是大一些的乌云，然后是大大的乌云。

接着还是：小乌云——大一些的乌云——大大的乌云……乌云飘上天空，越积越多，越积越厚。
轰隆隆，轰隆隆……
哗啦啦，哗啦啦……
太好啦，月亮街终于下雨啦！

[P10] 杰克把好心眼儿女巫装魔法药水的瓶子撞翻了。请你贴一贴，按照“大肚子瓶子——细细长长的瓶子——星星瓶子”的顺序，把它们摆放回柜子里吧。

月亮街下雨了，大家非常开心。雨停后，好心眼儿女巫放了好多魔法烟花。你知道好心眼儿女巫是怎么放烟花的吗？请观察图片，说一说，贴一贴。
full_text_en:
[P1] Math is here!
Find patterns, discover the arrangement rules of objects, and sort them.
Sorting by Pattern
Oh no, everything is messy!
Text by Zhong Linjiao, Illustrations by Bi Man
Jin Dun Publishing House

[P2] On Moon Street, there is a house with a pointed roof, and inside lives a kind-hearted witch.
Whenever children on Moon Street knock on that big door, the kind-hearted witch will use magic to create strange and wonderful toys.
For example—
Lollipops that make you dream sweet dreams.
Bouncing shoes that can jump to the clouds.

[P3] What if—
A child can't stop hiccuping? Go find the kind-hearted witch—she's the one to turn to. Just take a sip of the red magic potion—aren't you thinking: I'll stop hiccuping right away!

Wrong! Wrong!
The hiccuping child still hiccups, but every time he does, colorful clouds puff out of his mouth. First red, then yellow, then blue, then red again, then yellow again...
What color comes after yellow? Right, blue. What comes after blue? Red. What comes after red?
Enough already! People who keep asking questions aren't always very cute.
Alright, alright, no more questions.

[P4] If—
any child has a scary nightmare, going to the kind-hearted witch is always the right choice. Just
say 'nightmare' into a rainbow-striped pouch—do you think: nightmare turns
into a good dream!

Wrong! Wrong!
The child who had the nightmare still remembers it, but from that rainbow-striped pouch,
small monsters will jump out. First, a monster with no horns, then one with one horn,
then one with two horns, then again one with no horns...
And then? What kind of little monster will jump out after the one with no horns? Right,
one with one horn. And then what kind of little monster will jump out?
Enough already, people who keep asking questions aren't very cute sometimes.
Alright, alright, no more questions.

[P5] If only—
If only the kind-hearted witch could use magic to make it rain in Moon Street, it would be perfect. Moon Street hasn’t had rain for a long time.

The kind-hearted witch is trying hard to remember how to make it rain. The method is actually very simple, but the kind-hearted witch has forgotten.

I’m really sorry!

[P6] Boy Jack and girl Mira came to visit the kind-hearted witch to see if they could help her find the magic to make it rain.
Her big door was left open. The kind-hearted witch was sleeping on the table. She hadn't slept for days and nights. Shh! Don't disturb her. Let her sleep well.
Jack and Mira came to the cabinet full of magic potions. The bottles had all sorts of shapes. Mira looked at them from right to left, top to bottom, and found they were arranged in a pattern: first the round-bellied bottles, then the long and thin bottles, and then the star-shaped bottles.

[P7] Suddenly—
Clatter!
Jack accidentally knocked the bottles off the shelf.
Oh no, everything is messy!
Luckily, no bottles were broken, and luckily, they didn’t wake up the kind-hearted witch.
Jack and Mira put the bottles back in order, reciting as they went: "Big-bellied bottle, long and thin bottle, star-shaped bottle; big-bellied bottle, long and thin bottle, star-shaped bottle..."

[P8] "Burp... burp..." Suddenly, Mira started burping. Jack found a bottle of red potion that could stop burping — it was in a big-bellied bottle.
"Let's try it!"
But Mira's burping only got louder and louder...
"So noisy —" the kind-hearted witch was woken up by Mira's burping. She jumped up irritably.
"Oh my, you've spat out so many dark clouds." The kind-hearted witch was stunned, and after a long pause, she finally said a sentence.
Mira didn't come to play. She didn't want to spit out colorful clouds. What if she drank a little from each of the three bottles? What would happen?

[P9] Yes, after Mira drank the potions from the three differently shaped bottles,
with each burp, dark clouds floated out of her mouth:
first small clouds, then bigger ones, then huge ones.

Then it continued: small clouds—bigger clouds—huge clouds... The clouds floated up into the sky, gathering more and more, thicker and thicker.
Boom, boom...
Splash, splash...
Great! The Moon Street is finally raining!

[P10] Jack knocked over the bottles of magic potion that the kind-hearted witch had placed. Please stick them back in the cabinet, following the order: 'round-bellied bottles — long and thin bottles — star-shaped bottles.'

It rained in Moon Street, and everyone was very happy. After the rain stopped, the kind-hearted witch set off many magic fireworks. Do you know how the kind-hearted witch set off the fireworks? Please observe the picture, explain it, and stick it.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页是绘本的封面，标题为《按规律排序》，副标题为《哎呀呀，全乱了》，作者为钟林姣，绘者为碧曼。画面中一个女孩和一个男孩正在互动，男孩手持玩具，女孩吹着红色气球，背景简洁，突出主题。
[P2] 本页介绍了月亮街上住着一位好心眼儿女巫，她会为敲门的孩子们用魔法变出稀奇古怪的玩具，例如能做美梦的棒棒糖和能跳到云朵上的弹跳鞋。
[P3] 本页描绘了孩子打嗝时去找好心眼儿女巫，喝下红色魔法药水后，打嗝并未停止，反而嘴里冒出按红、黄、蓝规律循环的彩色云朵，女巫无奈地表示问个没完的人不太可爱。
[P4] 一个孩子做了噩梦后去找好心眼儿女巫，女巫从彩虹条纹口袋里变出按规律循环的小怪兽，孩子不断追问下一个怪兽的样子，女巫无奈表示问个没完的人不太可爱，最终孩子停止提问。
[P5] 月亮街长时间没有下雨，好心眼儿女巫正努力回忆让天空下雨的魔法方法，但遗憾地忘记了，她为此感到抱歉。
[P6] 小男孩杰克和小女孩米拉来到好心眼儿女巫家，发现她因忘记下雨的魔法而疲惫地睡着了。他们来到放满魔法药水的柜子前，米拉发现药水瓶按大肚子、细长、星星的规律排列。
[P7] 杰克不小心撞倒了柜子里的魔法药水瓶，米拉和他一起按照大肚子、细长、星星的规律将瓶子重新摆回原位，而好心眼儿女巫则在旁边熟睡。
[P8] 米拉打嗝，杰克给她喝了红色药水，但她的打嗝声反而变大，嘴里吐出乌云，吵醒了正在睡觉的好心眼儿女巫，女巫惊讶于她吐出的乌云，并思考如果她喝下三种药水会怎样。
[P9] 米拉喝下三种形状瓶子的药水后，每打一次嗝就吐出越来越大的乌云，乌云聚集在天空，最终下起了雨，月亮街终于下雨了。
[P10] 本页展示了两个互动游戏：左侧是按规律（大肚子、细长、星星）将撞倒的魔法药水瓶重新摆回柜子；右侧是观察好心眼儿女巫如何放魔法烟花，并进行贴纸互动。画面中女巫正在放烟花，天空中有花朵、冰淇淋等烟花图案。
